title: LeapXpert, which lets companies and sports franchises monitor staff business chats via apps like WhatsApp for compliance, raised $180M led by Riverwood Capital (Lucinda Shen/Axios)
summary: Lucinda Shen / Axios: LeapXpert, which lets companies and sports franchises monitor staff business chats via apps like WhatsApp for compliance, raised $180M led by Riverwood Capital — LeapXpert, a startup for companies to monitor external messaging apps, raised $180 million led by Riverwood Capital, it tells Axios exclusively.
